Ina Qvist is a healthcare professional and academic based at Aarhus University Hospital, where she works as a nurse and holds the degrees of cand.scient.san. and Ph.D. [^src1]. She is actively involved in national cardiovascular health initiatives in Denmark, specifically serving as a member of the steering group for the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] [^src1]. 

Her role on the steering group is documented in the database's annual report covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. This report outlines the data foundation, coverage, and validity of the registry, which serves as a critical basis for clinical and political decision-making regarding atrial fibrillation in Denmark [^src1]. As a steering group member, Qvist contributes to the oversight and quality development of this national clinical database.
